name: 100Hires
description: 100Hires is a recruitment software that includes talent sourcing, and applicant tracking to accelerate your company's hiring process.

events.d: Update a candidate's contact info, location, profile answers, or resume. Only fields you fill are updated.
Find candidates by job, stage, email, or advanced filters.
Add one or more tags to a selected candidate.
Create a candidate with contact details, location, profile answers and resume, optionally applied to a job.
Apply a candidate to a job at a chosen pipeline stage, with an optional resume.
Move an application to a selected pipeline stage and optionally include related resources (candidate, CV text, job).
Reject an application and optionally provide a rejection reason or suppress the rejection email.
Mark a candidate's application as hired.
Create a note for a candidate with body, visibility, author, and optional mentions.
Schedule an email to a candidate from a chosen mailbox, sent in 15 minutes or at a set time.
List users with optional page and page size settings.
List jobs with optional keyword, status, department, date filters, and pagination.
Retrieve all job status labels for use in filters or dropdowns.
List mail accounts with optional pagination (page and size).
Retrieve pipeline stages for a selected job by job ID or alias.
List applications filtered by job, candidate, stage, status, dates, or AI score.
List all rejection reasons for your company, returning each reason's name and ID.
